prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right one depends on what you need (industry, channels, budget, timeline, target audience). I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions first:

- What services do you need? (e.g., digital advertising, SEO, social media, branding, PR, content, B2B lead gen, e‑commerce)
- What’s your monthly or project budget range?
- Are you looking for a local agency near a particular city (Baltimore, Annapolis, Columbia, etc.) or is remote fine?
- Do you need experience in a specific industry (healthcare, legal, tech, nonprofits, retail)?

While you answer, here are practical tips to find and evaluate top agencies in Maryland:

1) Define success criteria
- Primary goals (traffic, leads, sales, brand awareness)
- Key KPIs and acceptable ROI/timeframe

2) Where to look
- Clutch.co, UpCity, Google Business/Maps, LinkedIn, Better Business Bureau
- Local resources: Maryland Chamber, Maryland Tech Council, local business groups

3) How to evaluate candidates
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (not just pretty work)
- Client references and retention history
- Depth of expertise for your channel/industry
- Team size and who will work on your account
- Reporting cadence, tools/tech stack, and communication style
- Pricing model and contract flexibility

4) Vetting questions to ask during calls
- Can you show two case studies with similar goals to ours? What were the KPIs and results?
- Who will manage our account and can we meet them?
- What will the first 90 days look like?
- What reporting will we receive and how often?
- Can we do a small paid pilot/project to start?

If you tell me the answers to the questions above (services, budget, location, industry), I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that match and include pros/cons and suggested interview questions.
